sefaria-text-segment-error.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference that was loading.

sefaria-bilingual-segment-error.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference that was loading.

sefaria-source-card-error.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference that was loading.

sefaria-source-select.detail: `position` is the selected segment's position as an array of numbers. `ref` is its reference.

sefaria-connections-category-change.detail: `category` is the chosen category's ID, or `null` for all categories.
sefaria-connections-category-change.preventDefault: Stops the panel from switching to that category and returning to the first page.

sefaria-connections-page-change.preventDefault: Stops the panel from changing page.

sefaria-connections-preview-request.preventDefault: Stops the panel from loading previews itself. If you don't call it, a panel that loads from `sref` requests the connections again with their text.

sefaria-connection-select.detail: `id` is the connection's ID. `targetRef` is the connected text's reference.
sefaria-connection-select.preventDefault: Nothing. The panel has no default action for this event.

sefaria-connections-panel-error.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference that was loading.

sefaria-reader-back.detail: `originEntryId`, the entry the Reader was showing
sefaria-reader-back.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from going back.

sefaria-reader-history-activate.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `entryId` is the history entry chosen. `label` is its label.
sefaria-reader-history-activate.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from returning to that entry.

sefaria-reader-pane-change.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `pane` is `"source"` or `"connections"`.
sefaria-reader-pane-change.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from switching pane.

sefaria-reader-chat-export.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `targetRef` is the reference to send.
sefaria-reader-chat-export.preventDefault: Nothing. The Reader has no default action. Your page handles the export.

sefaria-reader-source-select.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `position` and `ref` are the same as in `sefaria-source-select`.
sefaria-reader-source-select.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from selecting that segment.

sefaria-reader-connections-category-chan.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `category` is the same as in `sefaria-connections-category-change`.
sefaria-reader-connections-category-chan.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from switching category.

sefaria-reader-connections-page-change.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `page` is the same as in `sefaria-connections-page-change`.
sefaria-reader-connections-page-change.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from changing page.

sefaria-reader-connection-select.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `id` and `targetRef` are the same as in `sefaria-connection-select`.
sefaria-reader-connection-select.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from opening the connected text.

sefaria-reader-connections-preview-reque.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from loading previews.

sefaria-reader-error.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the Reader's requested reference. It can be empty when the failure came from supplied `data`.
